links.outcome: Readability (FRE, FKGL) of chatbot responses versus recommended patient education thresholds
links.effect: No platform reached FRE ≥ 60 or FKGL ≤ 6; median FKGL ranged from 13.1 (ChatGPT) to 21.4 (Perplexity), p < 0.001.
links.quote: No platform reached the recommended FRE ≥ 60 or FKGL ≤ 6 thresholds: median FKGL ranged from 13.1 (ChatGPT) to 21.4 (Perplexity), with ChatGPT producing the most readable and Perplexity the least readable content (p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated patient education content relative to recommended grade level
links.effect: All three chatbots exceeded the FKGL ≤ 6 threshold; median FKGL 13.1 to 21.4.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of three LLM chatbots answering patient FAQs regarding orthopedic surgery, evaluated by expert surgeons and standard readability formulas without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
